::: {#exr-risk-ratio-switch-ref}

Let:

- $\risk_1$ and $\risk_2 > 0$ be the [risks](#def-outcome-risk) of a [binary](data.qmd#def-binary-var) outcome in group 1 and group 2.
- $\riskratio \eqdef \risk_1 / \risk_2$ be the [risk ratio](#def-risk-ratio) of group 1 compared with group 2.
- $\riskratio > 0$.

Express the risk ratio of group 2 compared with group 1, $\risk_2 / \risk_1$, in terms of $\riskratio$.

:::
